screens.name: 01-today
screens.note: The paper on the step: masthead, dateline, the press turning, today's section line.

screens.name: 02-question
screens.note: A pressed answer: the ink sweep landed, the stamp hanging past the margin, the correction pencilled in, the footnote set.

screens.name: 03-result
screens.note: The edition printed: the score at 112pt, the tally, the tier stamp, the brass ribbon.

screens.name: 04-scorecard
screens.note: The file: the run at 96pt over one ledger line, and the month printed in ink.

screens.name: 05-paywall
screens.note: Needs -fakeProducts: a scheme's StoreKit configuration is never honoured by a simctl launch, so real products are unavailable and the CTA would sit disabled.

screens.name: 06-practice
screens.note: The composing room, locked: the type case as its hero, the bullets as ruled lines.

screens.name: 07-onboarding
screens.note: The first screen anyone sees: the masthead over the drawn hand press.

screens.name: 08-settings
screens.note: The desk: sounds, what has been filed, and the attribution as the section footer.

moments.name: answer
moments.note: The ink press: the app answers question four itself, so the sweep, the stamp and the tally square are on camera.

moments.name: win
moments.note: The edition printing: press rule, masthead, the score counting to 112pt, the tally, the tier stamp, the paper flying, the ribbon.
